hakkimizda.subtitle: KrediZeka is a financial technology company that helps individuals make more informed and secure financial decisions using artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies.
hakkimizda.mv_subtitle: We work to make financial decisions more accessible and transparent for everyone.
hakkimizda.mission_body: To enable individuals to objectively evaluate their financial profile before applying for a loan. With AI-powered analyses, we work to increase citizens' financial literacy and minimize unnecessary loan rejections.
hakkimizda.vision_body: To become Turkey's most trusted financial AI platform by 2030. We continuously develop our technology to build a world where every individual can access a real-time, personalized, and unbiased financial advisor.
hakkimizda.stats_subtitle: The success we have achieved in a short time is proof of our reliability and technology.
hakkimizda.values_subtitle: These values guide us in every decision we make and every feature we develop.
hakkimizda.value_transparency_desc: We openly share the methodology and reasoning behind every analysis. Our users can always understand what result they received and why.
hakkimizda.value_trust_desc: We fully comply with BDDK and KVKK regulations. Your data is protected with Bcrypt encryption and secure server infrastructure; it is never shared with third parties.
hakkimizda.value_innovation_desc: We continuously update our machine learning models, adding new financial indicators and algorithms to improve prediction accuracy.
hakkimizda.team_subtitle: A strong team of experts experienced in fintech, AI, and product development.
hakkimizda.team_member1_bio: 15 years of fintech and digital banking experience. Expertise in strategic leadership and AI-based financial product development.
hakkimizda.team_member2_bio: PhD in Computer Engineering. 12 years of experience in machine learning and big data infrastructure. Lead architect of the KrediZeka ML pipeline.
hakkimizda.team_member3_bio: Industrial Engineering graduate. Expert in user-centric product development and data-driven decision processes. 8 years of financial product strategy experience.
hakkimizda.cta_desc: Calculate your credit approval probability in seconds with our AI-powered risk analysis system.
